events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music and Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, was held from August 15 to 18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the original '3 Days of Peace & Music'. What was your favourite Woodstock performance, or the one you wish you'd seen?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who passed away at his Graceland home on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music lives on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was fatally shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who left us too soon. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world remembers Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His guitar wizardry continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, which was the last album they recorded together.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: An iconic album cover and timeless tracks. Celebrating the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman and rock icon Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' is a message that still resonates today. Celebrating John Lennon's iconic album.

events.title: Original iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years since Apple changed how we carry our music. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond/Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' and commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Standout
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Remembered
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the unforgettable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
